mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has stabilized around -22% over the past four weeks with no significant deterioration. This plateau signals that the floor of retail demand has been reached, and absent further shocks, retail mobility will revert toward baseline over the next four weeks, producing a positive direction.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC range t-3w to t-0w is -24.4 to -21.9, variance 1.3
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days falls below -23% (further decline from current plateau).

mechanism_narrative: Persistent RESIDENTIAL elevation (6.7 to 7.7% above baseline) combined with stable GROCERY_PHARM demand (-1.7 to -3.6%) indicates households remain home-anchored and are meeting essential needs locally. This behavioral lock-in suppresses discretionary retail visits, keeping RETAIL_REC depressed over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: TRANSIT rises above -25% within two weeks and RETAIL_REC does not increase correspondingly by at least 1.5 percentage points.

This seasonal shift redirects discretionary time away from outdoor recreation toward indoor retail venues, producing a positive direction in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS declined 16.2 points from t-3w to t-1w
fact:PARKS at 12.1% in t-0w suggests seasonal transition
failure_condition: PARKS rebounds above 20% and RETAIL_REC does not increase, or RETAIL_REC decreases despite PARKS collapse.

candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises more than 1 percentage point week-on-week
failure_condition: WORKPLACES falls back below -31% in the next two weeks or RETAIL_REC does not increase despite sustained WORKPLACES recovery.
